question: In a certain code language, ‘FLOWER’ is written as ‘KQTSAN’. How will ‘WINDOW’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae5efc115000d38a9442de7b29614b0d0cdf1ada7f25abd4e79483f28121110.png] 

‘FLOWER’ is written as ‘KQTSAN’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3f43c9a957af58b44d87865b4bed552ae8851d30b46f2a6c0f4e350fd2f2668.png] 

Similarly,

‘WINDOW’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0aea50d395043115a2f7a4db3efc1b39b6e04452e0b819d71f5ebb6b30d5c0e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"BNSZKS".**
